thread:
jess-ops: FYI opened a PR to fix route propagation for GPU subnets and tidy pool tags. staging CI apply is failing with ENI attach errors — can someone take a quick look? :eyes:

matt-infra: link?

jess-ops: https://git.company/infra/pulls/4823
code snippet:
```
resource "aws_route" "gpu_subnet_route" {
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.gpu.id
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  network_interface_id = aws_network_interface.gpu_eni.id
}
```
apply error: `Error attaching ENI: InvalidParameter: ENI not in same AZ`

deploy-bot: terraform apply (staging) failed — CI logs: https://ci.company/jobs/2118 — exit code 1 :warning:

kai-sre: my guess is AZ mismatch between subnet and ENI. can you paste the plan snippet where the ENI is created?

jess-ops: plan excerpt:
```
+ aws_network_interface.gpu_eni
    subnet_id: "subnet-0abc123" -> "subnet-0abc123"
    availability_zone: "us-west-2a" -> "us-west-2b"
```
that looks like AZ drift during plan, weird

anna-plat: i'll take a look. if it's AZ drift we should prefer using subnet_id only or read AZ from the subnet resource rather than hardcoding. @matt-infra can you check the module that sets ENI affinity/tags?

matt-infra: yep — module currently sets availability_zone from a var that is region-keyed, not AZ-keyed. quick fix: set availability_zone = aws_subnet.gpu.availability_zone or remove availability_zone override entirely so AWS picks it from subnet_id.

jess-ops: pushing a patch to remove the AZ override, re-running CI now

deploy-bot: terraform apply (staging) succeeded — plan+apply OK :white_check_mark:

matt-infra: lgtm, left one tiny nit on the PR description. can we hold merge until the 10:00 PST maintenance window so we can watch canary?

jess-ops: yep will merge at 10:00 and monitor canary for 30m after. thanks all :thumbsup:
